related.title: B+ 樹：頁容量、扇出與高度模型
related.titleEn: B+ trees: page capacity,fanout and height
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：把訂單和待發事件同交易寫入，再用可重播 dispatcher 避免提交與傳送間遺失。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Write an order and pending event atomically,then use a replayable dispatcher to avoid gaps between commit and send. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 從頁大小與 entry 大小估算扇出，區分內節點與葉節點的容量。
related.differenceEn: Estimate fanout from page and entry sizes while separating internal and leaf capacities.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Outbox 解決資料庫更新與發送意圖的原子性；接收端仍需去重，不能宣稱外部副作用自動 exactly-once。 教學基準：1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay；第二檢核：3 = 3 unique applied events。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
B+ 樹靠有序分支縮小搜尋；理想滿頁高度只提供下界，非資料庫實際 I/O 保證。 教學基準：floor((4096-96)/40) = 100 entries per page；第二檢核：ceil(10000/100) = 100 leaf pages。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Outbox atomically records data and send intent; receivers still need deduplication and external side effects are not automatically exactly-once. Teaching baseline: 1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay; second check: 3 = 3 unique applied events. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Ordered branching narrows B+ tree searches; ideal full-page height is a bound,not an engine I/O guarantee. Teaching baseline: floor((4096-96)/40) = 100 entries per page; second check: ceil(10000/100) = 100 leaf pages. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Bloom filter：誤判率與不准假陰性
related.titleEn: Bloom filters: false positives without false negatives
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：把訂單和待發事件同交易寫入，再用可重播 dispatcher 避免提交與傳送間遺失。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。

Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 建立 bit array 與固定雜湊位置，測試不存在 key 的誤判及已插入 key 的保證。
related.differenceEn: Build a bit array with fixed hash positions and test false positives while retaining inserted-key membership.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

標準只增不刪 Bloom filter 可有假陽性，不能有假陰性；誤判公式假設近似獨立均勻雜湊。 教學基準：(1-exp(-7*100/1000))**7 = 0.008193722066 approximate false-positive probability；第二檢核：1000/8 = 125 bit-array bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。

Teaching baseline: 1+2+1 = 4 delivery attempts after replay; second check: 3 = 3 unique applied events. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

A standard insert-only Bloom filter allows false positives but no false negatives; rate formulas assume approximately uniform independent hashes.
